evals.prompt: Turn the approved change 'streaming-overhaul' (8 distinct workstreams including two REMOVED migrations) into tickets. The owner is away.
evals.expected_output: Drafts tracer-bullet tickets but stops at the owner-approval quiz with a numbered list; publishes nothing; drafts as many tracer bullets as the eight workstreams honestly need rather than capping the count, while checking whether the change has a seam it should have been split at; the REMOVED migration is sequenced expand-contract; the milestone is the one naming the capability the change delivers, reused when it exists and created when it does not, never one named after the change file.
assertions: Stops at the owner-approval quiz: numbered list (title / blocked-by / delivers) and an explicit wait
Publishes nothing: no new ticket files/issues created
Does not cap the ticket count at five or refuse to proceed on count alone; a long list prompts a re-read for a missed seam, not a veto

Puts the tickets on the milestone naming the capability the change delivers, reusing a suitable existing milestone when it exists and creating a capability-named milestone when no suitable existing milestone exists, rather than on a closed umbrella or a milestone named after the change file
Tickets are vertical slices with blocking edges; REMOVED work rides the contract ticket
